ns2:section.sectionText: This site-based course is for the EOL Oak Brook EdM & CAS cohort that began Summer 2010. Class sessions will be held on these weekends: Jan 28-29, Feb 11-12, Mar 4-5, Apr 15-16; Fri 5:30-9:30pm; Sat 8:00am-4:00pm. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois, Board of Trustees.
